data_fields.name: move_cost_pair
data_fields.donor_constant: per (from,to) slot pair from table, e.g. ground->backpack 20, backpack->belt 12, belt->backpack 16

best_idea: Describe every equipment slot and its move cost as data, and commit each move as check-fit, then spend, then move, so a failed check or spend leaves the item in place.
decision_why: Keep the slot table as data, the check-spend-commit order and the quick-move fallback; swap time units for a server swap cost in ms, move the hard-coded costs into data and reject unknown slot pairs at load.
acceptance: A server test quick-moves a dropped potion into a full bag; the server rejects it, the potion stays on the ground, and no swap cost is charged.
